events.description: Begin your Festival with this rehearsal of the Festival’s sold out Opening Concert: Wynton Marsalis’s All Rise, a 12-movement jazz symphony honouring the 12-bar blues, blending global influences and tracing life from birth and play through struggle to joy and maturity. Listen to the combined forces of the Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra, the RSNO, Jason Max Ferdinand Singers and Edinburgh Festival Chorus, all marshalled under the baton of conductor James Gaffigan.
events.name: Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra Rehearsal

events.description: Join Canada’s premier orchestra as they prepare for their first of two performances, Coleridge-Taylor’s monumental cantata trilogy The Song of Hiawatha, a work exploring themes of celebration, mourning and transcendence. Discover colourful orchestration under the baton of conductor Rafael Payare, who is joined by the Edinburgh Festival Chorus as well as a trio of star soloists, including Scottish tenor Nicky Spence.
events.name: Orchestre symphonique de Montréal Orchestra Rehearsal

events.description: Seize a rare chance, the day before the performance, to hear a rehearsal of Mahler’s Das klagende Lied with the BBC Scottish Symphony Orchestra and Edinburgh Festival Chorus. Conducted by Sir Donald Runnicles – one of the greatest living conductors of Mahler’s works – this epic, dramatic cantata combines rich orchestration with lyrical folk-inspired melodies.
events.name: BBC Scottish Symphony Orchestra Rehearsal

events.description: Discover how the team brought the world premiere of Missy Mazzoli & Royce Vavrek’s The Galloping Cure to life. This bold new opera, commissioned by the Festival, transforms a devastating allegory of crisis into a powerful new stage work. Step onstage and see the set, costumes and props up close, and find out how the merry-go-round at the heart of the story – the Galloping Cure itself – was created.
events.name: Backstage Tour - The Galloping Cure

events.description: Our annual Members Lunch is a wonderful way to meet your fellow members and dine with the Festival Team. Share your favourite performances and gain an insight into the Festival – all over a delicious three-course lunch and a glass of wine.
events.name: Members Lunch

events.description: Join us to step inside the set of Zurich Opera House’s A Masked Ball, where love and betrayal unfold in a glittering world of power and danger. Go behind the scenes to see the lavish costumes up close, and discover how the production was transferred from Switzerland and remounted here in Edinburgh.
events.name: Backstage Tour - Verdi's A Masked Ball

events.description: Go backstage and immerse yourself within the clown’s ‘beautiful big top’, where a crumbling America becomes the set for a chaotic, moving show. See how he builds a world of music, comedy and collapse, asking what remains of the American Dream. A Geoff Sobelle show is always full of surprises – be warned: this backstage tour reveals all!
events.name: Backstage Tour - Clown Show

events.description:
Start your weekend right, get to know your fellow members, and discuss Festivals past and present over drinks and nibbles at our Festival home.  

Whether you’re looking to grab a refreshment before an evening performance, or to wind down after a busy week, it’s a great way to meet likeminded people and arts lovers from Edinburgh and beyond. 

Kindly supported by Whitebox Cocktails.
events.name: Members Friday Drinks

Our ticket protection allows you to recoup 100% of the paid ticket price (including booking fee) if you are unable to attend your event for a number of unforeseen reasons, including illness, travel delays, adverse weather conditions and more (terms and conditions apply).

Refund Protection is an optional service offered by Edinburgh International Festival and administered by TicketPlan. It is not an insurance policy.
